final:

What I did find: Priya Sharma (@priya.sharma) posted "Heads up: the demo video is ready for final review." on Sep 15 at 8:30 AM EDT — but it's in **#marketing**, not #launch-plan. There are two launch channels in your workspace (#launch-plan and #launch-plans); the message isn't in either.

Want me to add the 👀 reaction to the one in #marketing instead?
